run_pump_generator: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
convert_pump_source: convert pump meta programming source text into generated C++ code using ConvertFromPumpSource
parse_pump_ast: parse pump source text into an AST using ParseToAST for programmatic inspection
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated C++ code by wrapping long lines to 80 columns using BeautifyCode
tokenize_pump_source: tokenize pump source text into tokens using the Tokenize generator for custom processing
